examples.en: I want to dye my hair black.

examples.ko: 이 가방은 검정과 흰색 두 가지가 있어요.
examples.en: This bag comes in two colors, black and white.
Today I wore all black, top to bottom.

explain: '검정'은 명사라서 '검정 양말'처럼 다른 명사 앞에 바로 쓸 수 있어요. 형용사 '검다'는 '검은 양말'처럼 모양이 바뀌어요. '검은색', '까만색'도 많이 써요.

phrases.nuance_en: Widely used with the same meaning as '검정'.

phrases.nuance_ko: '검은색'과 뜻이 같고, 말할 때 더 편하게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as '검은색', and it sounds more casual in speech.
The adjective '검다' changes to '검은' before a noun.

explain_en: '검정' is a noun, so it can go directly before another noun, as in '검정 양말'. The adjective '검다' changes its form: '검은 양말'. '검은색' and '까만색' are also commonly used.

dis.h: short noun form without color suffix

p.n: 까만색 feels like a deeper, pitch black.

examples.ko: 박물관에 들어가기 전에 주의 사항을 들었어요.
examples.en: Before going into the museum, we heard the safety rules.

examples.ko: 아이가 있는 집은 특히 주의가 필요해요.
examples.en: Homes with small children need to be especially careful.

examples.ko: 바닥이 젖어 있어서 입구에 주의 표지판을 세웠어요.
examples.en: The floor was wet, so they put up a caution sign at the entrance.

examples.ko: 이 약은 먹을 때 주의 사항이 많아요.
examples.en: This medicine has many cautions when you take it.

examples.ko: 이 길은 사고가 많아서 운전 주의 구간이에요.
examples.en: This road has many accidents, so it is a drive-with-caution zone.

explain: 말할 때는 “조심하세요”를 더 많이 쓰고, 안내문에는 “주의”가 많이 나와요.
explain_en: In speech, “조심하세요” is more common. On signs and notices, you will see “주의” more often.

examples.ko: 눈가가 어두워 보이는데 잠은 잘 자요?
examples.en: The area around your eyes looks dark. Are you sleeping okay?
I cried a lot, so my eyes are red around the edges.
Please apply the lotion gently around your eyes.
My makeup smudged and the area around my eyes turned dark.
The skin around my eyes was swollen and itchy, so I put on ointment.

explain: 눈가는 눈 둘레의 피부예요. 눈꺼풀(eyelid)은 눈을 덮는 피부라서 달라요.

dict_examples.en: Tears welled up at the corners of Mother's eyes.

explain_en: 눈가 is the skin around the eye. 눈꺼풀 (eyelid) is the skin that covers the eye, so they are different.
